overview_description.description:
LNDDO is the pioneer of digital lending for SMEs in MENA. The company leverages technology and big data analytics to deliver innovative credit products to businesses across the region with a current focus on the UAE, Egypt and KSA.

Through its proprietary digital loan underwriting and origination technology platform, it is delivering financing solutions to vast sections of the economy underserved by traditional financial institutions. It is developing partnerships to fund working capital for SMEs through ecosystem partners such as payment gateways, e-commerce, large manufacturing supply chain corporates and F&B Manufacturers.
